scene: The vendor hands you a steaming, leaf-wrapped parcel tied with striped twine.
picture: Flat side view on the platform. Far left sits an iron crate where a striped badger naps. Centre stands the grandfather in navy apron holding his bicycle with plant crate, clutching a leaf-wrapped bento parcel. Right, the vendor waves behind his counter. Far right, a brass escalator rises up to the street.
shown: a steaming leaf-wrapped lunchbox held in the player's hands at the centre
a gleaming brass escalator rising towards city streets on the far right
a curled, striped badger napping atop an iron crate on the left

variants.scene: The warm, leaf-wrapped bundle smells delicious as steam gently curls into the air.
